description: A substantial Romano-British settlement, dated between the 1st and 4th CE. A rectangular enclosure was identified with a circular building and two ancillary buildings inside, this was identified as a possible shrine, though more accurate dating is not available.
bibliography: Hume. “Site Specific Archaeological Evaluation at Somerdale, Cadbury Limited.,” 1993. https://doi.org/10.5284/1029138.
Martyn, Blick, Brindle, and et al. “Somerdale, Keynsham (Traiectus).” The Rural Settlement of Roman Britain: an online resource, 2015. https://doi.org/10.5284/1030449.
